en:
## New Features

- Terminal tool now supports create and rename actions, and can resolve terminals by name (case-insensitive)

## Bug Fixes

- Improved handling of partial messages on narrator interruption: fixed content reading timing, removed redundant variables, and enhanced debug logging
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 终端工具新增创建和重命名操作，支持按名称（不区分大小写）解析终端

## 修复

- 优化叙述者中断时的部分消息处理逻辑：修正内容读取时序，消除冗余变量，增强调试日志
